05 / A little about me

Curious about robots.
Grounded in the world.

Taehyoung Kim.

I’m a Research Engineer at Fraunhofer IVI, working on robotic perception and aerial autonomy. My research connects video understanding, multimodal sensing, and semantic representations of the world in 3D.

I’m interested in the space between a promising research idea and a system that works beyond the benchmark. This site brings together my publications, experiments, and, over time, notes on what I’m learning and building.
